purpose: Make Bag End read as the P1C01 hero landmark and lived-in narrative hub without changing quest ownership, increasing AI population, or inventing an unshipped interior.

source_scope.shire: Warm domestic scale, circular Hobbit architecture, gardens, low-threat exploration, deterministic Birthday/departure state variants.
source_scope.bag_end: Dense lived-in domestic language and narrative-hub readability. Current car owns exterior approach/state dressing only because no dedicated production interior shell exists.
source_scope.f1_01: Birthday preparation/social state before Bilbo leaves and the Ring passes to Frodo.
source_scope.f1_02: Ring-danger/packing/departure state before Frodo leaves the Shire.

architecture.world_builder: Geometry/dressing and direct references to spawned Bag End state actors only.
architecture.quest_subsystem: Sole state truth; delegates drive variant changes.
architecture.repeated_detail: AWorldDetailCluster HISM, zero Tick, no collision.

visual_layers: Hero approach framing from the Hobbiton footpath toward Bag End
Garden/property-edge lived-in detail around the existing round-door landmark
Domestic work/storage clutter placed away from the traversal line

asset_policy.missing_asset_behavior: Skip optional detail; never synchronous-load it

acceptance.boundary: Source implementation candidate. Exact-head Pre-Unreal and UE4.27.2 proof pending; PIE/device/visual/pacing/performance remain separate evidence.
